transform.qs: return { eventdata: `{"title":"{{parameters.title}}","dateandtime":{"start":"${(() => { const t = new Date(); const y = t.getFullYear(); const m = `${t.getMonth() + 1}`.padStart(2, '0'); const d = `${t.getDate()}`.padStart(2, '0'); return `${y}${m}${d}`; })()}", "end":"${(() => { const t = new Date(); t.setDate(t.getDate() + 1); const y = t.getFullYear(); const m = `${t.getMonth() + 1}`.padStart(2, '0'); const d = `${t.getDate()}`.padStart(2, '0'); return `${y}${m}${d}`; })()}", "timezone":"Asia/Kolkata"}}` };
